description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_HandoverToLogistics" name="Handover to logistics provider"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShipmentStatus" name="Shipment status"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Logistics" name="Logistics Provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Handover" name="Handover to logistics provider" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Participant_Logistics"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ShipmentStatus" name="Shipment status" sourceRef="Participant_Logistics" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderChannel" name="Order channel"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" name="Place order via online platform"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" name="Place order by phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickAndPack" name="Pick and pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOver" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_HandoverToLogistics"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MonitorMerge" name="Shipment monitoring"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveStatus" name="Receive shipment status" messageRef="Message_ShipmentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delivered" name="Delivered to customer address?" default="Flow_NotDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Delivery successful"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Gateway_OrderChannel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OnlineChannel" name="Online" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PhoneChannel" name="By phone" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderChannel" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderOnline" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrderByPhone" targetRef="Gateway_OrderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderMerge" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickAndPack"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_PickAndPack" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOver"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_HandOver" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStatus" targetRef="Gateway_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delivered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotDelivered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivered" targetRef="Gateway_MonitorMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or Return Handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Feedback or return received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessFeedbackOrReturn" name="Process feedback or return"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeedbackProcessed" name="Feedback or return processed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_ProcessFeedbackOrReturn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="EndEvent_FeedbackProcessed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
